meta.title: Features — ExperimentLens
meta.description: Every capability ExperimentLens ships: parallel-coordinates run analysis, comparative views, explainability (PDP, ALE, counterfactuals), experiment catalogue, workflow drill-down and an extensible adapter API.
meta.ogDescription: The full feature surface of ExperimentLens — visual analytics & explainability for ML experiments.

hero.title: The full surface of ExperimentLens.
hero.subtitle: ExperimentLens is the visualization layer on top of your tracking server and execution engine. It makes every metric, parameter and artifact you log explorable, comparable and explainable.

showcase.title: What you can do in ExperimentLens.

features.title: Hundreds of runs, one parallel-coordinates plot.
features.body: Sort, filter and group runs by any parameter or by any metric you logged to MLflow. The linked parallel-coordinates view reveals which configuration choices actually move the numbers you care about.
bullets: Live filtering between table and chart

features.title: Compare runs side-by-side across metrics, models and data.
features.body: Select any subset of runs and switch between Metrics, Models and Data tabs. Mosaic and stacked layouts let you spot regressions and tradeoffs in the metrics you logged.

features.title: PDP, ALE and feature importance — wired to your runs.
features.body: Open the Explainability tab to see global and local post-hoc explanations attached to the same experiment context. No notebooks, no glue code.

features.title: Every experiment, every workflow, in one place.
features.body: A central catalogue of all tracked experiments with status, owner and last-update — backed by MLflow runs and Kubeflow pipeline executions.
bullets: One click into the full experiment view

features.title: Drill into a single workflow's parameters, metrics & artifacts.
features.body: Inspect the exact parameters, metrics and artifacts that the run logged to MLflow. Ratings and status help curate the runs that matter.
bullets: Direct link from any comparative view

deep.title: The full feature surface.
deep.subtitle: Everything ExperimentLens currently ships, at a glance.

items.title: Comparative analysis
items.body: Mosaic & stacked layouts to diff metrics, models and datasets across selected runs.

items.title: Variability points
items.body: Treat hyperparameters and engine settings as first-class axes you can group, color and filter by.

items.title: Linked filtering
items.body: Brush the chart, the table follows. Filter the table, the chart updates. One mental model.

items.title: Any metric you log
items.body: Every metric ExperimentLens shows comes from what your runs log to MLflow — accuracy, fairness, latency, custom KPIs. Nothing is hard-coded.

items.title: Pipeline monitoring
items.body: Track pipeline progress (completed / running / failed) and steer human-in-the-loop refinements.

items.title: Artifact & data inspection
items.body: Preview inputs, outputs, predictions and intermediate artifacts in context with the run.

items.title: Counterfactuals & PDP / ALE
items.body: Apply post-hoc explainability methods directly inside the experiment context.

items.title: Extensible adapter API
items.body: Add a new tracker or engine without touching the frontend — the adapter contract is the only seam.

items.title: Human-in-the-loop
items.body: Use diagnostic views to adjust configurations and re-launch refined pipelines as part of the same experiment.
